name: loverocks
description: A procedural rock studio: Rust/Wasm signed-distance rocks rendered with Three.js

scripts.build:wasm: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~ --remap-path-prefix=$PWD=." cargo build --locked --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/wasm engine/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/fjord_engine.wasm
